prompts.text: Which of our friends gives the funniest relationship advice without trying?
Tell us about a time you helped two people understand each other during an awkward moment.
Play matchmaker between compatible friends or let everyone meet naturally?
Two friends ask you to introduce them at an event, but they have completely different interests. What's your opening line?
Friends often notice compatibility in people's humour before their interests.
The best introductions describe what people enjoy rather than what they earn.
What's one harmless sign that two people have become close friends?
Recall a pair of friends who seemed unlikely to get along but surprised everyone.
We have to plan a group activity for friends who have never met. What might help them connect?
Exchange funny stories about the group or play a guessing game about everyone's preferences?
What's the funniest way a friend has described their relationship status?
Tell us about somebody giving romantic advice after admitting they've never followed it themselves.
A first-date story with an awkward ending or a family introduction that went unexpectedly well?
A friend asks the group for a harmless icebreaker before meeting someone they like. What would we suggest?
Friends sometimes give more theatrical dating advice than the situation deserves.
A relaxed first impression beats a speech written by committee.
Which ordinary quality would you mention if you were introducing a friend to someone new?
Recall a time friends helped somebody prepare for a meeting without making them nervous.
Your friend wants a date idea that doesn't require dressing formally. What would you suggest?
A first meeting over coffee or a short activity where conversation happens naturally?
Who in our circle is most likely to remember everyone's birthdays without a reminder?
Describe a time a friend made a celebration special through a small but thoughtful idea.
Surprise someone with a scrapbook or plan a silly mini awards ceremony?
We have to celebrate three friends with different preferences on the same day. How should we split the attention?
The person who organises surprises often finds it hardest to accept one.
A low-pressure celebration is kinder than surprising somebody who dislikes being watched.
What's the oddest birthday wish you've received from a friend?
Tell us about a surprise that almost failed because someone gave away the secret.
We invent awards for the friend who remembers tiny details. What would the trophy look like?
Get a surprise call from all your friends or individual messages containing favourite memories?
Which family relationship has taught you the most about good-natured teasing?
Tell us about a sibling disagreement that became a family joke years later.
Share embarrassing childhood pictures with friends or childhood nicknames with permission?
Your sibling joins a gathering with your friends and begins telling old stories. Which one would you stop them telling?
Siblings often remember versions of one another that friends have never seen.
Being related doesn't give someone unlimited rights to tell your embarrassing stories.
What's the most unexpected thing you've discovered about a friend's family?
Recall a family gathering where a friend felt like an honorary relative.
You meet a friend's parents and they invite you to join an unfamiliar tradition. How would you respond?
Hear your friend's funniest childhood story or let them describe their most memorable family holiday?
Which friend could deliver a serious pep talk without sounding serious for even a minute?
Describe a time a friend encouraged you with an unusual but useful comparison.
Receive a hilarious motivational recording or a practical checklist from a friend?
We're trying to encourage someone before their first public presentation. What harmless group ritual might help?
Some friends encourage others with jokes while keeping the underlying message sincere.
Knowing when to stop joking is part of knowing someone well.
What's a line from a friend that made you laugh and feel supported at once?
Tell us about helping a friend practise an uncomfortable conversation.
A friend wants constructive criticism but gets defensive easily. How would you keep feedback kind?
Rehearse a nerve-racking introduction with a friend or ask them to listen silently first?
What kind of friend would you trust to organise a surprise group outing?
Recall a social event where a friend's small thoughtful detail changed the mood.
A carefully organised dinner or an informal outing with room for spontaneous detours?
Our group has to host visiting friends with different budgets. Which activities would you shortlist?
People often reveal who they're most comfortable with by where they choose to sit.
Good hospitality means making the quietest guest comfortable without singling them out.
What's a simple courtesy that makes you want to return to someone's home?
Describe a host who made you feel welcome despite knowing you only casually.
Two guests both need a little space during a noisy gathering. What should we arrange?
An outdoor game with friends or an indoor meal where everyone brings something?
Which friendship habit makes you roll your eyes affectionately?
Recall a time friends insisted on a ridiculous tradition for no obvious reason.
Be the friend who creates group nicknames or the one who invents odd traditions?
Your friends publish a fictional guide to spending time with the group. What's chapter one called?
Groups develop social rules that nobody remembers agreeing to.
Some group traditions deserve retirement as soon as they stop being fun for everyone.
What's an inside joke our friends have somehow kept alive for years?
Tell us about introducing a new friend to a very old running joke.
A newcomer asks why everyone cheers when a particular song plays. How would you explain?
Bring back an abandoned group tradition or create something new for the next gathering?
What's an unlikely friendship you admire among people you know?
Tell us about a time someone's friendship surprised you because their personalities differed.
Get to know a friend's quiet colleague or their wildly outgoing cousin?
Two people at our table have opposing tastes in almost everything. What topic might help them connect?
People sometimes build their closest friendships around shared values rather than matching hobbies.
A surprising friendship is more interesting than two people agreeing about everything.
Which difference between you and a close friend has become a source of laughter?
Recall getting an unexpected perspective from somebody younger or older in your circle.
A friend wants to reconnect with someone after a long gap. What might be a comfortable first invitation?
Reconnect over a familiar meal or try an activity neither person has done before?
Which social habit would you put on a fictional friendship etiquette exam?
Tell us about forgetting a minor social rule and recovering with good humour.
Ask before bringing an extra guest or surprise friends with somebody everyone already knows?
Our group invents a friendly etiquette manual for movie nights. What's the first rule?
People have surprisingly different ideas about when friendly teasing becomes too much.
Respecting someone else's no makes a social invitation easier to accept next time.
What's a polite way to tell friends you need a quiet evening?
Recall a friend understanding your decision to leave a gathering earlier than planned.
Someone shares a personal story and everyone begins asking questions. How might you give them space?
A group tradition where everyone speaks in turn or an open conversation with no fixed order?
Which friend has introduced you to someone who later became important to you?
Describe a moment when you realised two different friendship circles had begun to overlap.
Bring friends from different parts of your life together or keep some gatherings separate?
Two of your friends meet and become closer to each other than either expected. How would you celebrate it?
Friendship networks change as people introduce new partners, colleagues and neighbours.
A new connection between old friends doesn't need to change your place in either friendship.
What's an unexpected shared interest you found between two friends you introduced?
Recall a gathering where everybody left having made at least one new acquaintance.
We're asked to host a reunion involving people from very different periods of our lives. How would we begin?
End an evening with a shared photograph or exchange one amusing memory from each guest?
